scripts.build: node scripts/copyPdfjsAssets.mjs && vite build && esbuild server.ts --bundle --platform=node --format=cjs --packages=external --sourcemap --outfile=dist/server.cjs
scripts.build:native: node scripts/copyPdfjsAssets.mjs && vite build --mode native && esbuild server.ts --bundle --platform=node --format=cjs --packages=external --sourcemap --outfile=dist/server.cjs
scripts.android:sync: npm run build:native && node scripts/pruneNativeWebDir.mjs dist && npx cap sync android
scripts.android:apk: npm run android:sync && node scripts/androidGradle.mjs assembleRelease
scripts.android:aab: npm run android:sync && npm run check:payment-surface && node scripts/androidGradle.mjs bundleRelease
scripts.test:rules: npx -y firebase-tools@13 emulators:exec --only firestore --project mylectures-rules-test "node scripts/rules.test.mjs"
